title: China Price Check: $120 Great Wall Tour, or $20 Solo? | China Travel Expert
description:
The Great Wall costs about $20 to see yourself — so why do day tours from Beijing charge $90–$120 a person?

At Mutianyu, the entrance ticket is just ¥40 (about $6). A round-trip express bus from Beijing runs roughly ¥80, and the parking shuttle is ¥15 — so a do-it-yourself day lands around $20 per person. Private Beijing day tours quote $90–$120+ and usually still add the entrance, shuttle and cable car on top. You're paying for a driver, a guide and convenience — not a cheaper or better wall.

🧭 Expert Tip: buy the ¥40 ticket on the official account or at the gate, take the 916 express bus from Dongzhimen, and keep the ¥120 cable car optional — the walk up is half the fun.

长城自己去只要约20美元，报团却要90–120美元——多出来的钱买的是司机和省事，不是更好的长城。
